What we do

Our Services

From resin bound driveways to commercial groundworks, every job is laid to the same high standard with hard wearing materials and a tidy finish.

Resin Bound Driveways

Smooth, permeable and low maintenance. A premium finish in a range of natural stone colours.

Block Paving

Classic, durable driveways and paths laid in the pattern and colour to suit your home.

Patios and Paving

Indian sandstone, porcelain and natural stone patios that make the most of your garden.

Tarmac Driveways

Strong, cost effective surfacing for driveways, car parks and access roads.

Cleaning and Sealing

Restore and protect existing driveways and patios with deep clean, re-sand and seal.

Commercial and Groundworks

Larger scale paving, surfacing and groundworks for commercial and trade clients.

About us

Meet the Team

Stoneway Paving and Resin Driveways Ltd is a family run business covering Gloucestershire, Bristol, Bath, Somerset and South Wales. We specialise in resin bound surfacing, block paving and quality groundworks, and we treat every driveway as if it were our own.

Whether it is a small front path or a full commercial scheme, our focus is the same: solid preparation, premium materials and a finish that lasts.
